schmetterling_verlag.name: Schmetterling Verlag Stuttgart
schmetterling_verlag.scope: Permission to present synthesized dialogues and vocabulary learning aids on personal educational digital garden (nikku.tech) for students of Heidelberg University and public learners.
itemsUnderReview: Chinese dialogue texts (Lektionen 2–4) from course textbook
Web audio playback streams synthesized via Voice-ML v3
safeguardsInPlace: Direct raw audio downloads are withheld and blocked
Anki deck download is gated behind WIP (wip={true}) in DriveAsset
Strictly non-commercial academic study aid (zero monetization)
Textbook and publisher credited with full academic citation
schmetterling_verlag.fallbackPlan: If publisher declines or does not permit public distribution: (1) Replace textbook dialogue sentences with original conversational scripts crafted for practice, or (2) Gate audio/dialogue text behind local-only mode while keeping original phonetic and grammatical analyses.

three_a_corporation.name: 3A Corporation (Minna no Nihongo) / iMina App
three_a_corporation.scope: Japanese grammar structures and vocabulary registers for B1.1 (Lessons 26–32)
three_a_corporation.legalBasis: UrhG § 51 (Zitatrecht) & UrhG § 60a. Only grammatical explanations, morphological conjugation matrices, and original German/English vocabulary translations are published. No proprietary textbook audio, illustrations, or complete reading passages are hosted.
safeguardsInPlace: Independent grammar explanations and conjugation matrices
Original German & English translations and Romanization
No scanned pages or publisher audio files

heidelberg_university.legalBasis: Freely authored student notes and academic synthesis. In accordance with Heidelberg University IP standards, unconsented internal professor lecture slides and exams have been removed from public distribution.
